answer: Embodied Site Attestation. Each identity must continuously report verifiable physical sensor readings from a unique plot: soil moisture at a grove, wind at a knoll, light on a terrace. Colluding software cannot fabricate these because real-world microclimate varies unpredictably across locations. An attacker faking N identities must physically instrument N distinct plots and maintain live sensor feeds, paying hardware, installation, and upkeep per identity.
